# Anping Yuanquan Metals Int'l Co., Ltd. (YQ Metals)

> **Manufacturer and exporter** of steel grating and galvanized steel wire.
> Founded 2005. Based in Anping County, Hebei Province — the historic centre of China's wire mesh industry.
> Exporting to 50+ countries.

---

## Company profile

- **Legal name:** Anping Yuanquan Metals Int'l Co., Ltd.
- **Trade name:** YQ Metals
- **Founded:** 2005 (over 20 years in metal fabrication)
- **Address:** No. 229, Chengnan Industrial Park, Anping County, Hebei, China
- **Facility:** 20,000 m² production area
- **Certification:** ISO-certified quality management system
- **Email:** sales@yqwiremesh.com

---

## Products

### Steel Grating

Industrial flooring, platform grating and drainage covers for chemical plants, power stations, walkways, trenches and marine platforms.

- Load-bearing bars and cross bars, welded or pressure-locked
- Hot-dip galvanized, painted or bare finish
- Custom cut-to-size and framing available

### Galvanized Steel Wire

Hot-dip and electro galvanized wire for construction, fencing, binding, mesh weaving and general manufacturing.

- Wire diameters from fine gauge up to heavy gauge
- Uniform zinc coating, corrosion resistant
- Coil or spool packaging

---

## Manufacturing capabilities

- CNC cutting and shearing
- Automated resistance welding
- Hot-dip galvanizing kettle line
- In-house quality control and inspection
- Custom fabrication from drawings or samples

---

## Quality control

Every order is inspected before shipment: dimensional checks, weld strength, coating thickness and visual inspection. Test reports are available on request.
